characters.name: Mr. Harris
characters.voice_notes: Polite, careful parent. Curious and thoughtful, a little formal.
characters.key_line: "My son had problems with bullying at his old school. How do you handle that?"

turns.line: Good evening! Welcome to Westfield High. Can I help you?
Yes, I'm Mr. Harris. We're choosing a school for my son. How do you educate your students?
We use small classes and plenty of discussion. Every student studies the required subjects first.
How do you give grades? Do you have many exams?
We use continuous assessment. A student's grade comes from their work all year. They write two assignments every month.
What about phones? Do you allow them in class?
We allow phones at break time. We ban them during lessons.
My son had problems with bullying at his old school. How do you handle that?
We take bullying seriously. Students report it to us. We talk to everyone. We expect good behavior from all students.
Does every student do work experience?
Yes, in the final year. They spend three weeks in a real workplace.
That sounds good. When does the school year start?
In September. Bring your son to visit us. We'd love to meet him.
